items.text: Hi Pilots!

Thank you so much for your patience with this one, it took sometime but with all systems approved and the patch rolling out we can now update the PC version of the game! Below is the list of changes coming with this patch:
Fixed a logic issue where it would skip certain splash screens
Fixed a logic issue with main menu navigation
Corrected UI issues in credits and options menus
Corrected hazard lines in 1.7
Corrected hitboxes in 1.7
Fixed a timing issue with 1.6
Fixed hitboxes on the orange death walls to be more consistent game wide
Fixed VFX issue with 2.11
Fixed VFX issue with 2.12
Fixed lighting issue with 4.4
Fixes an issue where you could skip ahead to levels even if not unlocked
Fixed VFX issue on teleporter hazards

Thankfully alot of the fixes were more based on just some small clean up instead of anything game breaking but as always if you notice anything please use our discussion page on Steam or our community discord (link on side panel or below this post).
We also want to take the time to thank those who have picked up the game this Steam Summer Sale!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119689/fd7ff391fa2256d23b4762fc8b28de026e7ee1f7.jpg"]
Til next time pilots!
Ryan

releases.displayName: March Update: Loc Plans and Launch Schedule

items.text: Hi pilots!
It's been a while, we have been knee deep in trailer creation, marketing plans and storefront creation for the console launches of Nullstar: Solus.

We are happy to announce that the release date is locked in and the announcement for that will go live very soon (I know we keep saying this, but seriously its a process). We did want to share something though with you all... localisation!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119689/eb1135173f61d336ea9cf63a9910b36dfd4a531a.png"]
From Ryan and the Team! See you soon pilots!
Hello pilots!

It’s been a crazy few weeks and the team is finally back in their respective locations as they work hard towards the launch of Nullstar: Solus! Just recently the team confirmed their beta complete build and is now working on getting all the final things in place for the main game.

A lot of this comes in the form of the game's decryption system. Some of you have noticed this in trailers, screenshots and at playtest sessions. So let’s go over the decryption system and how it ties to our narrative and unlocks.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119689/5a50819173e0efbdad68b1957604484c1d15ad5c.png"]

The decryption system works as part of our narrative system, powered by Yarn Spinner, taking a page out of FromSoft games, the player unlocks the story through codex entries tied to how well you do in the main game.

Each medal time is tied to our progression where with each medal you earn (up to 3 per level) working towards unlocking a codex entry. Once you receive a certain number of medals, you unlock a codex entry.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119689/fe5716e09bedfcd82d7f344ca826b496335a3b68.png"]

These entries tell a small story within the world of Nullstar but also come with their own rewards ranging from ship skins, new ships (all of which handle a bit differently from the Solus and Titan) and give you access to the master levels. Remixed versions of previous levels, some of which you can play in the demo.

The codex paired with our leaderboards, 5 worlds and unlocks gives you a variety of options to play the game and experience the world of Nullstar. We look forward to having some launch details for you very soon.
Remember the demo is still available and is currently part of the Indie Brew demo disc which you can sign up for here.
See you out there soon pilots!

releases.displayName: October Update - Steam Next Fest Demo

items.text: Hello pilots!
It is currently 4am here at home base and we are happy to officially launch the Steam Next Fest demo for Nullstar: Solus, our take on the precision platformer!

Thank you to all those who got in early and have been racing against the clock to collect the fragments of the Nullstar. As previously mentioned this demo features 20 levels from the main game (all of world 1 and 5 mastery levels to really test your metal).
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119689/bf6847a727b77a4da16bb4a5a024a206a914fca8.png"]
For those coming from the playtest the big things to note are:
A reworked tutorial, better explaining the air-brake system and the importance of why managing your thrusters and air paths are key.
Level structure balancing, we have tweaked when some levels take place to make on-boarding easier.
Level balancing, we have made some levels easier, some harder and added some curveballs.
SFX and VFX updates.

The demo will run from October 13th to 20th and is a showcase of the team’s incredible hard work as well as the support, you and fellow pilots, have provided. We already have an active discord (which you can click here to join) that have been sharing times and participating in our community competitions.
We will be running another competition starting on the 14th of October (AEDT), more details available via our discord.

Thank you to all those who came by over PAX Australia weekend, it was fantastic to meet alot of you and talk about the game and all the excitement involved! We are now in Sydney for SXSW Sydney so if you are attending please come say hi and look out for updates on socials and discord.

Overall it's been a very exciting few weeks since the last update and it's even more exciting to see the road ahead as we look towards launch. If you haven't already please consider wishlisting the game and we look forward to sharing launch information with you very soon!
Safe travels pilots!
Hello pilots!

Firstly we want to thank the overwhelming response to the demo. The team has been so grateful for the support. As we are a small team, things do fall through the cracks and we are thankful that players have been able to point us in the right direction for fixes.
Fixes to ultra widescreen support.
Fixed issue with audio duplication.
Players can now press a button to instantly turn on all thrusters for faster decision making.
Updated tutorial to include new mechanic.
Fixed the text in the tutorial to actually reflect the current input device,
Fixed some bugs that allowed tutorial stage skipping,
Fixed glitchy text animation everywhere,
More input standardization and input indicator fixes (pause menu is now completely fluid and up to date, updated manual and settings all behave as expected).
Fixed an issue where the leaderboard was not communicating with server.
Cideoen
Hey pilots! We are back with another monthly update!

Over the past month we have been putting the final touches on some of our end game levels namely worlds 4 and 5. It has been amazing to see the team work together to create some truly gorgeous looking levels but also from the level design side of things... a bit mean.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119689/449dfa7500d6653d5ceeb3a7bb37d4399778ce6b.png"]
Some of the newer levels have been going through some vigorous play sessions though to make sure they don't cause to much grief for players.

The aim of the game is to be hard, but not hurl your controller and break things hard. So this month has been a lot of playtesting and tweaking of levels to make sure they are not just challenging but also fun.

This week we had a local meet up with Tas Game Makers in Launceston. It was great to meet so many new faces as well as see some old faces and talk about everything games and how we as a state are working to put our mark on the games industry.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119689/180d6ca2f0ad276e1afbcef3a670533ef861be7f.jpg"]Photo provided by Tas Game Makers, learn more here.
Our next major event is PAX Aus 2025!

We are taking a build of the game that features a bunch of fixes from the playtest, updated tutorial, control changes and some previews of other levels! We are excited to becoming back to Melbourne and showcasing what we have achieved over the last 12 months.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119689/d828369448c8f56fe9f733ce76dd6227e6a06a8b.jpg"]
So if you are there, make sure to stop by and say hi! Check out the game and of course chat with us to help us make this the best game it can be! Speaking of showcases though...
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119689/b610e1606764f5e461d009f691da06d499b4ceb9.png"]

Nullstar has been accepted into the 2025 ANZ indie showcase hosted by The Indie Brew. Last years event was amazing and we can't wait to showcase the game alongside other incredible ANZ games. Make sure to tune in on September 5th AEST.

And that's it for this month. We are as always hard at work on the game and trying to hit the necessary milestones for launch. You can keep in touch via our Discord or socials which can be found on our Steam page.
Til next time pilots!
Hello pilots!

We are back with another update this time for July! The team has just come back from Adelaide and participating at AVCon 2025. It was a fantastic event with a deeper focus on interacting with players. Sometimes events like PAX and that cause of the volume, you don't really get to spend much time with players so events like AVCon and TGX are great ways to meet you all and chat about the game.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119689/bba04d45343dbd723dd9ead4302555a53e6f5533.jpg"]

Speaking of the game, things are progressing positively as always. As we have explained in the past, the major lift of the game currently is the bespoke art for each level. We just wrapped up all the levels for world 3 (small teaser below) and are excited to begin our in house QA to make sure these levels not only look great but play great as well.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119689/14949a891d93df82615fd0f640b0b0b7ab99397d.png"]

As we enter the back half of the year we will be slowing down on events and really only currently have PAX Aus (Oct 10th - 12th at the MCEC in Melbourne) and SXSW Sydney (Oct 13th - 19th in and around Sydney) as our planned events. We will update if anything changes!
Til next time!

releases.displayName: March Update - TGX and Preparing for Con Season!

items.text: TGX and Other Events

Over the past week we participated in TGX (The Game Expo) up in Melbourne as well as some other smaller events with local game developers. We caught up with some friends at the new Massive Monster office (Cult of the Lamb devs) as well as had our resident musical maestro, Alec, showcase the game at GDC in San Francisco. It has been a great experience getting the game out there amongst other devs and showing why we think Nullstar is something special!
Art Updates

For a long time players have noticed an option on the menu called decryption and asked what that is. Well whilst we aren’t ready to fully reveal how it works yet we can share some art by the very talented Cassandra Lee (who previously worked with on Broken Roads). Cass joins the team to help with our in-game lore and is working closely with Anniemay to create the world of Nullstar.
Gameplay Tweaks

Following some recent local playtests at Optimal Gaming and more recently TGX we are looking at making some changes to level order, difficulty and some tweaks on mechanics. Nothing that will delay the game but some important changes that we hope will make for easier onboarding and allow players to chase those fast times.
Planned Conventions

We are happy to confirm that we will be attending AVCon 2025 in Adelaide (July 5 – 6) and Pixel Expo: IV in Perth (September 13 - 14). We will have the TGX demo with maybe some of the above gameplay tweaks but overall if you are interested in getting your hands on the game and are in those areas come say hi!
Social Media Changes

This is a quick update, we have moved all information about the game away from Twitter/X and are now exclusively on Bluesky. If you have an account and want information please click here and follow: here
